decisions.reason: As an organic salami platter that is very close to our core charcuterie know-how and remained listed in both 2023 and 2024, it fits our existing capabilities and shows enough market continuity to justify further exploitation and incremental refinement.

Although it built on our existing organic and salami knowledge base, its disappearance from the website by 2024 suggests weak enough traction that our limited development attention is better reallocated to stronger adjacent products.

This premium salami sharing snack is tightly related to our established salami expertise and was still marketed in 2024, indicating that we can continue to learn from and commercialize it with low capability risk.

The organic boiled pork sausage directly extends our traditional sausage competencies and our strategic push in organic lines, so as a 2024 launch it merits continued support while we use existing processing knowledge to improve it.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast leverages our slicing, seasoning, and premium cold-cut capabilities while supporting assortment expansion into organic variants, so it should be retained for further market learning after its 2024 launch.

This organic herb-coated salami is highly adjacent to our core salami and seasoning expertise and aligns with our organic expansion, making it a good candidate to keep while we exploit strong absorptive capacity in a familiar product space.
